// divguard:path coding/session.go

package coding

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

type store struct{}

func (store) AppendMessage(msg string) (string, error) { return msg, nil }

type Session struct {
	inner store
	ids   []string
}

// persistMessage fails the run when the transcript cannot be saved.
func (s *Session) persistMessage(msg string) error {
	id, err := s.inner.AppendMessage(msg)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("persist message: %w", err)
	}
	s.ids = append(s.ids, id)
	return nil
}

func (s *Session) tryPersist(msg string) {
	if id, err := s.inner.AppendMessage(msg); err == nil {
		s.ids = append(s.ids, id)
	} else {
		panic(err)
	}
}

// cleanup and hashing are not persistence.
func cleanup(tmp string, data []byte) [32]byte {
	defer func() { _ = os.Remove(tmp) }()
	h := sha256.New()
	_, _ = h.Write(data)
	var sum [32]byte
	copy(sum[:], h.Sum(nil))
	return sum
}

type block struct{ out []string }

// AppendOutput returns no error, so a bare call loses nothing.
func (b *block) AppendOutput(text string) { b.out = append(b.out, text) }

func render(b *block, buf *bytes.Buffer) {
	b.AppendOutput("done")
	buf.Truncate(buf.Len() - 1)
}
